description: Lists Directus automation flows with filtering, sorting, search and pagination. Use get_flow for one flow and its operations, get_operations for operations across flows, trigger_flow to run one. status narrows to active or inactive flows; folder (Directus 12.4+) narrows to one flow folder, where an empty string means root-level flows. Returns at most 25 flows unless limit says otherwise, and flow metadata only: operations are omitted unless get_flow asks for them.

folder.description: Directus 12.4+: only flows in this folder (folder ID); pass "" for root-level flows

name: get_flows
